high_level_description: The image depicts a close-up of an old, tattered piece of parchment with text written on it. The parchment is held up against a blurred background that appears to be a dimly lit room or space, possibly a library or study, given the presence of shelves and what looks like books or other items in the background. The text on the parchment reads: "The Sanctifiers have taken to striking the afflicted dead at the first signs of instability, rather than letting them live out the rest of their lives in peace. I cannot know if it is caution that guides them so... or cruelty.
